settings.title: Downloads
settings.enabled: Find and download music you don't have
settings.enabled_description: Adds a Discover tab to search and Download buttons on music that is not in your library. Downloads go through your download server and land in your library.
settings.address_description: The address of your naviseerr server, for example https://naviseerr.example.com. The server must list this Feishin address as allowed.
settings.address_desktop: Works in the web version of Feishin only for now.
settings.signedOut: You are signed out of the download server.

error.unreachable: Can't reach the download server at {{address}}. Check the address, and that it lists this Feishin address.

page.notFound: This isn't available on YouTube Music right now.

failure.SOURCES_EXHAUSTED: No source would send the file.
failure.METADATA_UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't find this on YouTube Music.

search.empty: Search for music you don't have yet.

landing.partial: Added to your library: {{title}} ({{failed}} songs could not be downloaded)

play.NOT_IN_LIBRARY: This song isn't in your library yet.
play.NOT_FOUND_IN_MEDIA_SERVER: The song is downloaded but your music server hasn't picked it up yet. Try again in a minute.
play.MEDIA_SERVER_NOT_CONNECTED: The download server is not connected to this music server.

playlist.queued: Downloading {{title}}. It goes into {{playlist}} when it's ready.
playlist.queuedMany: Downloading {{title}}. Its songs go into {{playlist}} as they're ready.
playlist.downloadFailed: {{title}} couldn't be downloaded, so it isn't in {{playlist}} yet. Try the download again.

gaveUp.NOT_FOUND_IN_MEDIA_SERVER: {{title}} was downloaded, but your music server never showed it, so it isn't in {{playlist}}.
gaveUp.PLAYLIST_GONE: {{playlist}} no longer exists, so {{title}} wasn't added.
gaveUp.NOT_EDITABLE: {{playlist}} can't be changed, so {{title}} wasn't added.
gaveUp.MEDIA_SERVER_NOT_CONNECTED: The download server lost its connection to your music server, so {{title}} isn't in {{playlist}}.
gaveUp.NOT_IN_DOWNLOAD: {{title}} wasn't part of that download, so it isn't in {{playlist}}.
